review.extracted_documents: All five PDFs and the supplied MATLAB visualization script read; report text includes result summaries.
review.exposure: Source report result/threshold summaries and documentation text were exposed during review. No raw CSV/workbook response rows opened, curve digitization, fitting or solver execution performed. Existing shared field audits had already accessed response rows. No blind-data claim. Full individual torsion header pages, including their published response plots, were visually inspected during verification. Subsequent source-integrity audit traversed all 17 DSS CSVs, parsing vertical-stress and excess-pressure columns. One preliminary inspection exposed the first logged six-channel row of the CSR0.105 file after its multiline header was mistakenly followed as if by units; the file has no separate units row. No response fitting, plotting or role assignment followed. A subsequent read-only XLS audit extracted selected specimen metadata cells from all nine processed workbooks. Earlier manual inspection also exposed initial worksheet rows and published/worksheet outcome summaries; no blind claim follows. Subsequent torsion processing audit traversed BIFF formula records and extracted selected first-row formulas and metadata without cached response values. Thesis state tables and material/apparatus pages were inspected; no blind-data claim. Subsequent zeroing integrity audit inspected every shared H:K formula definition and raw/processed C:F/H:K values at fixed rows22 and I16+1, plus H18:K18 summaries, in each workbook. Only identity residuals retained; no fitting/scoring/plotting or threshold outcome analysis. Embedded VBA source decompressed statically; no macro or workbook recalculation executed. A subsequent correspondence audit traversed all27raw acquisitions and their pasted workbook phase channels for complete/prefix fingerprints. Source numeric histories were not retained in the tracked record or used for fitting/scoring/plotting. Exact matches include sample numbers and every acquisition channel. Preliminary raw-header inspection also displayed initial rows.

dss.source_locator: El Ghoraiby and Manzari 2018, PDF pp. 5, 7, 10-11 (printed pp. 2, 4, 7-8)
dss.control: 17 stress-controlled constant-height DSS tests; no saturation phase; dry constant-height pluviation; lateral rings
dss.density_timing: Preparation procedure obtains initial e from mass and dimensions before 45-minute vertical consolidation. Table e0 is not established as the post-consolidation shearing state.
dss.pressure_observable: All 17 pinned CSVs satisfy Axial Stress + Excess Pressure = a per-file constant, compatible with reported decimal rounding. Thus the pressure channel is consistent with reference vertical stress minus current vertical stress. The inferred constant is not always the nominal 40/100 kPa or the first logged stress. This closes the numerical sign/redundancy convention; saturation equivalence, reference timing and apparatus-correction validity remain separate physical questions.
dss.uncertainty: Bender-element group means/COV are specimen-group variability, not per-test measurement noise or sensor accuracy.
source_conflicts: 100 kPa table rows 4 and 5 report density/void ratio combinations that warrant checking against the adopted Gs; retain both original values without correction.
Sensor list repeats Vertical Displacement for the 32 mm sensor; axis assignment unresolved.
List of symbols uses axial strain for threshold terminology while results use double-amplitude shear strain.

Supplied visualization script is headed LEAP 2017, labels shear channels as axial/deviatoric and labels stress both mean and vertical. Its ru division does not establish how the pressure column was generated.

pressure_audit.method: Intersection of the per-row sums with half a last reported decimal unit from each channel; no regression or model fit.
pressure_audit.result: 17/17 files admit a constant reference within printed-rounding intervals.
pressure_audit.score_consequence: Do not count pressure and vertical stress as independent response objectives under this transformation.
pressure_audit.limits: Printed-rounding compatibility is not a sensor-uncertainty estimate or proof of physical undrained equivalence.

torsion.source_locator: Uemura, Vargas and Ueda 2018, PDF p. 2 Tables 1-2; individual header pages listed per row
torsion.qualification: Per-specimen header components differ slightly from rounded table confinement and from exactly isotropic target states. Preserve reported precision; do not force all tests to 100 kPa or exactly K0=1.
torsion.remaining: Resolve the common-baseline processing inconsistency, normal boundary controls, particle density for void-ratio conversion and cross-campaign specimen/preparation reuse. Raw/processed phase correspondence is now resolved within the pinned release. Do not silently repair source histories.

chapter_crosswalk.locator: Vargas et al. 2024 Table4.2, PDF p.4 (printed p.104)
chapter_crosswalk.evidence: All nine rows match the 2018 release in both relative densities, actual confinement, shear stress and stress ratio. Sequential chapter labels are recorded per specimen.
chapter_crosswalk.consequence: Chapter apparatus and preparation methods now support the matched nine-test subset; extra seven tests are not added to the study.

apparatus.source: Vargas et al. 2024 Sec4.2, PDF p.2
apparatus.normal_pressure_boundary: equal inner and outer chamber pressures
apparatus.instrumentation: Internal load/torque cell; rotational potentiometer; axial dial gauge; burette-volume differential pressure transducer and separate pore-pressure sensor.
apparatus.uncertainty: Capacities and sensor types are reported, not calibrated accuracy. Table4.1 volumetric-sensor capacity is retained in the source as printed, not adopted as a verified accuracy/range.

normal_loading_intent.locator: Vargas et al.2024 Sec4.2, PDFp2, visually rechecked
normal_loading_intent.reported_intent: Same inner and outer pressures at all test steps; chapter states that no deviator stresses were applied in the isotropic tests.
normal_loading_intent.interpretation: This describes the intended normal loading alongside imposed torsion, not zero total deviatoric tensor stress: torsional shear itself produces deviatoric stress. Preserve individual measured initial components.
normal_loading_intent.still_unverified: Exact normal-load feedback, admissible axial movement and apparatus corrections; do not infer an axial-height constraint from undrained conditions alone.

preparation.source: Vargas et al. 2024 Sec4.3, PDF pp.4-6
preparation.method: constant-drop-height air pluviation; negative-pressure support followed by 20 kPa isotropic preconsolidation; CO2 and degassed-water saturation; about 200 kPa back pressure; drained isotropic consolidation then undrained stress-controlled sinusoidal torsion
preparation.qualification: Use individual 2018 headers and B values for actual states; protocol targets are not a replacement for measured components.

sensor_document_followup.review: Native worksheet cells read; no response measurements.
sensor_document_followup.finding: Release sensor types, capacities, manufacturers and models agree with the chapter table. The volumetric sensor capacity is printed as ±3200 psi in both; not independently established as a valid instrument range or accuracy.

workbook_metadata.locator: Nine processed XLS workbooks, Loading metadata cells and 波形データ!E5; exact addresses in extraction record
workbook_metadata.finding: Initial and post-consolidation dimensions, mass, volume and dry density recovered. All nine use maximum/minimum dry densities 1.757/1.491 g/cm3; independent arithmetic reproduces reported relative densities and mass/volume balances to floating-point precision. This is internal consistency, not independent metrological validation.
conflicts: Loading!B3 says target Dr=60% in Dr50-0.10 and Dr50-0.15; summary sheet says 50%, and actual computed states are near 48% initially. Preserve both labels.
Particle-density cells are cached empty in all nine workbooks; do not assign void ratio from an unlabelled borrowed Gs.
workbook_metadata.formula_status: Cached XLS outputs read without recalculating or tracing every original formula. Independent density-relative-density identity checked; not a full processing audit.

original_article_followup.review: Public primary-article text inspected via web; PDF retrieval unsuccessful, no pinned full-text snapshot or visual verification. Independent review pending.
findings: Article explicitly identifies the initial nine Dr50/Dr60 isotropic tests as the DesignSafe release; fourteen further tests are supplementary data, not additional admitted observations.
Article uses minimum/maximum dry densities 1490.5/1757.0 kg/m3; workbooks use 1491/1757. Preserve this small convention difference without overwriting cached states.

CSR is shear stress divided by initial mean effective stress; mean is the average of vertical, radial and tangential effective components. Do not universally replace it with vertical stress when extending to anisotropic tests.
original_article_followup.unresolved: Exact torque/rotation processing equations and specimen particle density remain unverified.

thesis_followup.locator: Vargas thesis Sec3.1.1 PDFp69, Sec4.1-4.3 PDFpp116-123; Table4-2 PDFp118
thesis_followup.finding: Nine state-table rows corroborate the release and chapter crosswalk under thesis labels Dr50-1-1 through Dr60-1-5. Thesis confirms1490.5/1757kg/m3 index dry densities and mean-effective-stress CSR. Exact processing equations are delegated to JGS-0551-2009, not recovered in reviewed passages.
thesis_followup.access: Legacy URL returned HTML. Current public PDF successfully retrieved via repository handle API and ORIGINAL bitstream; hashes and metadata snapshots pinned.

processing_formulas.finding: First-row observation equations recovered in all nine XLS files. Subsequent shared-formula and fixed-row cache audits identify a common torque-baseline subtraction across unlike channel units; the processed channel chain is not admitted.
processing_formulas.limits: All shared H:K definitions inspected and two fixed cached rows per workbook checked. Full-history cache evaluation, normal boundary controls, calibration and membrane corrections remain open.
processing_formulas.reader_caution: General xlrd formula decompiler can omit denominator parentheses; restricted RPN decoder preserves arithmetic grouping and has regression checks.

processing_followup.finding: Static VBA source review recovers cycle-extrema and threshold-bracketing conventions but does not explain zeroing switches. Shared-formula/cache evidence identifies a common-baseline unit inconsistency requiring provider clarification.

acquisition_correspondence.method: Exact binary64 acquisition-content fingerprints, including sequential sample numbers and every raw channel; no tolerance or fitted alignment.
acquisition_correspondence.finding: All27workbook phases have unique raw-acquisition matches. All18consolidation/reconsolidation phases match complete raw acquisitions; all9loading phases match exact prefixes with203–945 trailing raw samples omitted. Duplicate directory aliases are byte-identical copies, not additional specimens.
acquisition_correspondence.limits: Acquisition identity does not resolve processing corrections, apparatus interpretation, material/preparation independence or cross-campaign reuse.

next_steps: Torsion geometry, mass, index dry densities and pre/post-consolidation dry density are recovered; resolve particle density and observation transformations before initialization assignment.
Obtain DSS post-consolidation height/density, lateral initial stress, reference-pressure timing and apparatus corrections; the channel subtraction sign/redundancy is now numerically verified.
Resolve the two DSS CSR=0.105 rows/files without matching by response quality.
Review sensor accuracy, apparatus corrections and uncertainty; source capacities alone are insufficient.
Assign reviewed whole-specimen groups before protocol tuning.
